items.title: Who are the candidates in Brazil's presidential election?
items.dek: Voters in Sunday's election are choosing between two very different candidates, as Americas correspondent Ione Wells reports from Rio de Janeiro.

items.title: Almost 1,000 arrested as clashes follow another day of mass protests across France
items.dek: Officials have so far managed to avoid a repeat of last weekend's rioting and looting as hundreds of thousands took part in demonstrations.
